newsitem.title: UK: Hazlewood up on higher results.
newsitem.headline: Hazlewood up on higher results.

text.p: Shares in Hazlewood Foods Plc rose on Tuesday after the food processing company and fresh meats group reported a higher profit and increased dividend.
By 0812 GMT the stock was up 6p to 117p.
"The figures were in line with expectations but also the outlook is not bad", an analyst said.

Earlier Hazlewood said its pre-tax profit before exceptional items for the financial year ending March 1997, rose 8.8 percent 37.0 million stg. It proposed a total dividend of 6.9 pence per share, up three percent.

The disposal of its Dutch and Czech potato processing operations,R which earned Hazlewood 45 million stg, would pull down the gearing. Apart from that, cash generation and dividend progression made look the share undervalued at the current level, he said.
